critical_issues.what: Board state cache (_board_names, _board_rotations) not auto-synced with Player.board.grid mutations
critical_issues.why: StateStore.update_board() called manually; if Player.board modified outside this call, StateStore becomes stale
critical_issues.consequence: UI renders stale board state; dropped cards reappear; rotations reset
critical_issues.fix: Hook Board.place()/remove() to notify StateStore, or rebuild StateStore.board every get_public_state() call

critical_issues.what: Synergy BFS cluster algorithm copied in 3+ modules
critical_issues.why: Different implementations of same algorithm increase maintenance burden; bugs fixed in one place don't auto-propagate
critical_issues.consequence: Synergy scores differ between engine calculation and UI display; inconsistent balance
critical_issues.fix: Migrate all consumers to synergy_calculator.py; delete board.py and ui_adapter.py copies

critical_issues.what: Synergy group system hardcoded to exactly 3 types ('MIND', 'CONNECTION', 'EXISTENCE'); hex edge system hardcoded to 6
critical_issues.why: Both are literal constants in code; no registry or configuration
critical_issues.consequence: Impossible to add 4th synergy type without refactoring core; impossible to create non-hex board
critical_issues.fix: Create GroupRegistry (dynamic) and EdgeSystem config; move hardcoded values to constants dict

critical_issues.what: cards_bought_this_turn tracked in both Player.cards_bought_this_turn (int) and Player.stats['cards_bought_this_turn'] (int)
critical_issues.why: Both incremented separately in buy_card(); no shared source
critical_issues.consequence: One tracking system can desync from other; stats incorrect in UI
critical_issues.fix: Remove direct int; use only stats dict, or create single property

critical_issues.what: Errors handled by returning None or shim objects (_AdapterCardShim) instead of raising exceptions
critical_issues.why: Pattern: adapter.get_player(999) returns None instead of raising IndexError
critical_issues.consequence: Errors manifest as AttributeError downstream; hard to debug; no clear error context
critical_issues.fix: Replace shim pattern; raise EngineAdapterError with descriptive message
